review_inputs: frame_manifest.json and its eight original_frame_*.png files only
coordinate_system: Native original PNG pixels; x increases rightward, y downward, origin at top left. Centers and intervals are approximate visual estimates.
limitations: NOT_QUALIFICATION: development diagnostic review only; not held-out qualification or model-accuracy evidence.
One AI reviewer; no independent human labels or inter-reviewer agreement.
Full-frame visual inspection of the eight original PNGs; no detector, tracker, annotated media, prediction files, or audit output was inspected.
Tiny size, compression, motion blur, and overlap with bright court lines limit visual identification and localization.
Failure to discern a ball is labeled uncertain with a null center, not proof of absence or occlusion.
Error intervals express rough visual localization uncertainty, not calibrated confidence intervals.
Ball-streak centers estimate the middle of the visible streak rather than an exposure-instant physical position.
Frame mapping and source identity are copied from the supplied manifest; source media was not opened or independently decoded by this reviewer.
Labels are frozen before any prediction comparison and must not be revised in response to model output.
